accent-fallback.purpose: Only used when the Omarchy accent cannot be read; runtime binding is theme.accent.

current-title.purpose: Current media name; help heading uses its size only.

nativeQt.units: QML logical pixels; frontmatter px values are portable notation, not CSS source.
nativeQt.bodyTypography: Inherited Qt Material/platform font; no explicit global family or pixel size.

accent.updates: File/directory watcher, 80ms debounce; re-arms after replacement.

accentInk.rule: Relative luminance > .179 chooses black; otherwise white.

rounding.caveat: Material roundedScale and rectangle pixel radius are distinct Qt properties.

window.responsiveBehavior: One column; queue absorbs vertical changes and scrolls.

interaction.nativeStates: Hover, focus, pressed, and disabled use native Material rendering.

components.name: BeamButton
components.description: Material button with explicit contrast-aware highlighted Text item.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Accessible 40×40 icon tool control with 20×20 vector and delayed tooltip.

components.name: Queue
components.description: Flat clipped list with active accent tint, title/path, row actions, and explanatory empty state.

components.name: Output and standby
components.description: Display selection, projection action, named black/image standby, and state copy.

components.name: Transport
components.description: Current title, state, speed, timeline, playback, and volume anchored beneath queue.

nativeQt.previewPolicy: No HTML/CSS replicas generated: native QML components cannot truthfully render in the web shadow-DOM panel.

evidence.detector: Not applicable; native Qt. No detector ran.
evidence.limitation: Physical second-monitor placement unverified; only laptop display connected.

narrative.overview: Beam inherits Omarchy in Operate mode: a quiet dark native Qt Material controller with live accent, flat tonal hierarchy, and a readable queue. The separate mpv output shows only media or black/image standby; Stop and noncontinuous EOF preserve that output surface.
keyCharacteristics: Native Qt Quick Controls Material in dark mode
Live desktop accent and Hyprland corner behavior

rules.name: The Live Accent Rule
rules.body: Bind accent use to theme.accent and highlighted button ink to theme.accentForeground.

dos: Do keep output and standby above the flexible queue and transport below.
Do retain native accessibility and translation-aware layout.
donts: Don't freeze fallback accent or corner values into runtime styling.
Don't invent web tokens or font metrics.
Don't collapse stopped, paused, and standby states.
